questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 4$ and $x = 7$. Factoring $(x - 4)(x - 7) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 4$ and $x = 7$.

questions.q: A data set recorded for data distributions consists of the four values $\{14, 18, 22, 28\}$. What is the arithmetic mean? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $20.5$. The sum is $14 + 18 + 22 + 28 = 82$, and dividing by $4$ gives $20.5$.
